dockerfile.amd64:
FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG HEDGEDOC_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="chbmb"

# environment settings
ENV NODE_ENV=production \
  PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true \
  YARN_CACHE_FOLDER=/tmp/.yarn

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add -U --no-cache \
    fontconfig \
    font-noto \
    icu-data-full \
    nodejs-current && \
  apk add -U --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    git \
    icu-libs \
    npm \
    openssl-dev \
    python3-dev \
    sqlite-dev \
    yarn && \
  echo "**** install hedgedoc ****" && \
  if [ -z ${HEDGEDOC_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    HEDGEDOC_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/hedgedoc/hedgedoc/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/hedgedoc.tar.gz -L \
    "https://github.com/hedgedoc/hedgedoc/releases/download/${HEDGEDOC_RELEASE}/hedgedoc-${HEDGEDOC_RELEASE}.tar.gz" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /app/hedgedoc && \
  tar xf /tmp/hedgedoc.tar.gz -C \
    /app/hedgedoc --strip-components=1 && \
  cd /app/hedgedoc && \
  yarn install --immutable && \
  yarn run build && \
  yarn workspaces focus --production && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  yarn cache clean && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    $HOME/.npm \
    $HOME/.yarn \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3000
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-hedgedoc-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# copy config.json if doesn't exist
if [[ ! -f /config/config.json ]]; then
    cp /defaults/config.json /config/config.json
fi

# symlink uploads
mkdir -p /config/uploads
rm -rf /app/hedgedoc/public/uploads
ln -s /config/uploads /app/hedgedoc/public/uploads

# check for the mysql endpoint
if [[ -n "${DB_HOST+x}" ]]; then
    echo "Waiting for DB to be available"
    END=$((SECONDS+30))
    while [[ ${SECONDS} -lt ${END} ]] && [[ -n "${DB_HOST+x}" ]]; do
        if [[ $(/usr/bin/nc -w1 "${DB_HOST}" "${DB_PORT:-3306}" | tr -d '\0') ]]; then
            if [[ -n "${RUN}" ]]; then
                break
            fi
            RUN="RAN"
            # we sleep here again due to first run init on DB containers
            if [[ ! -f /dbwait.lock ]]; then
                sleep 5
            fi
        else
            sleep 1
        fi
    done
fi

# migration from codimd
if [[ -f "/config/codimd.sqlite" ]] && [[ ! -f "/config/hedgedoc.sqlite" ]]; then
    echo "Migrating codimd sqlite db to hedgedoc"
    mv /config/codimd.sqlite /config/hedgedoc.sqlite
fi

# permissions
lsiown -R abc:abc \
    /config

# set lockfile to avoid DB waits for this specific container
touch /dbwait.lock

units.name: svc-hedgedoc
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# if user is using our env variables set the DB_URL
if [[ -n ${DB_HOST+x} ]]; then
    export CMD_DB_URL="${CMD_DB_DIALECT:-mariadb}://${DB_USER}:${DB_PASS}@${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/${DB_NAME}"
fi

# set env var for sqlite if db url and db_host unset
if [[ -z ${CMD_DB_URL+x} ]] && [[ -z ${CMD_DB_HOST+x} ]]; then
    export CMD_DB_URL="sqlite:///config/hedgedoc.sqlite"
fi

# set config path
if [[ -z ${CMD_CONFIG_FILE+x} ]]; then
    export CMD_CONFIG_FILE="/config/config.json"
fi

# run program
exec \
    s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 \
        cd /app/hedgedoc s6-setuidgid abc node app.js

notes.upstream:
This release should fix the bugs in the withdrawn releases 1.12.1 and 1.12.2 by repairing the database.
Therefore, please inspect the release notes for 1.12.1 and 1.12.2 as well.

**Note:** This release changes the local database to enforce uniqueness on the email column for local accounts.
In theory your instance should not have duplicate email addresses. However, it might be good to ensure this is
true for your database as well and remove duplicate user entries otherwise.

The repair migrations - especially for SQLite - are a bit overcautious in order to not destroy any data.
In case your database has some weird situation which the repair does not recognize, it might abort and print a
message to the log. So, please check your log on the first start of your instance after this update.
Also remember to create a backup before updating.

### Security fixes

- [GHSA-5q59-fhxv-4r9x](https://github.com/hedgedoc/hedgedoc/security/advisories/GHSA-5q59-fhxv-4r9x) reports a possible authorization check bypass when validating OAuth2 role or SAML group claims.

### Bugfixes

- Fixed the failing migrations of 1.12.1 and 1.12.2
- Fixed registration breaking due to missing default values
- Fixed login breaking due to a circular dependency import
- Fixed permission check accessing invalid properties on realtime socket vs HTTP API
- Fixed the first slide being printed as an empty page in Firefox
- Fixed a crash on startup when `DATABASE_URL` is set and the config file has no section for the current environment, and `CMD_DB_URL` now takes precedence over the legacy `DATABASE_URL`

### Contributors

- [Patrick Lühne](https://github.com/pluehne)
- [Sri Venkateswaran](https://github.com/srivenkateswaran6002)
- [maluyckx](https://github.com/maluyckx)
- [Mayuri Phad](https://github.com/mayuriphad)
